bio: This hip bistro never fails to appeal. Trendy lighting, a vintage wood-burning stove and a full view of the chefs working in their flame-licked open kitchen. Ellen graciously and seamlessly supervises the front of house. A patriotic lineup of Flemish classics, complete with Asian twists and Mediterranean flair, are blended into enticing set and à la carte menus. Belgian staples such as eel have no secrets for the consummate chefs, who serve this family favourite in a sabayon of green herbs with heaps of piping hot crunchy fries. Or how about a fillet of halibut with a frothy velvety bearnaise sauce, nobashi shrimps and oyster leaf? Generosity shines through in every detail of this friendly bistro that hits all the right buttons!...
